content:
Resting 45 minutes gives 45 energy, then expending all 45 energy in 1 minute fills \(45(45+1)=2070\) barrels, so 46 minutes suffice.

To see 45 minutes cannot work: suppose in 45 minutes Mac rests \(r\) times and acts \(a\) times, so \(r+a=45\). In any action his current energy is at most \(r\), so if he spends \(k\), he fills at most \(r(k+1)\). Thus total barrels filled is at most
\[
r\sum_i(k_i+1)=r(a+\sum_i k_i)\le r(a+r)=45r.
\]
If \(a=0\), he fills 0 barrels. If \(a\ge 1\), then \(r\le 44\), so he fills at most
\[
45\cdot 44=1980<2012.
\]
Thus 45 minutes is impossible, and the minimum is 46.

\[
\boxed{46}
\]
